title: Is this an appealing visual style?
author: eslezer
selftext: I'm working on this lil rpg game and while I myself like the style I want to know what other people think. I've only been working on it for \~3 weeks so there still some UI changes I have to do and textures to fix, but this is like the overall vibe

comments.author: Briskfall
comments.body:
The between between elements (UI) feel clean, I like it!

It's quite easy on the eyes.

However, the character models feel a bit too "Roblox" ish to my liking. The black outline shading especially feels clumsy.

The background decorations (trees, rocks) look too basic and makes it look like a demo art this current point.

I would also work the transition effect from one portal to another -- but it is less of a priority than the other ones above which feels far more jarring.

tl;dr: On a good direction, generally speaking, but needs a lot of polish.

replies.author: eslezer
replies.body: thanks, i definitely need to change a lot of decoration outdoors and the rifts thingy. The outline comment is something I had thought about but wasn't too sure, I'll agree it gets too thick especially during those ultimates animation, ill probably tone that down a bit <3

replies.author: Briskfall
replies.body:
You're welcome. I'll also add a little follow-up since there seems to be a bit of misunderstanding:

It's not that it \[the black outline\] is *too* thick that's the problem. I know that it can be an appeal to some people.\^\[1\]

It's that there are some "gaps" where you can see the colour underneath that's the problem, where it makes the line look "sketchy." A sketchy look isn't bad on its own, but the reason why a sketchy look doesn't work all well here is due to the rest of the game looking "solid." Hence, it creates a tonal dissonance (lack of coherence).

And lastly, good luck on your game!

\---

\^\[1\]: (Seeing mobile games like Brawl stars and Cookie Run Ovensmash does this nicely)

comments.author: J0rdian
comments.body:
You avoided having a bunch of different art styles that clash like a lot of people using AI seem to do. I like that you are sticking to a specific style so it doesn't look that amateurish.

It's decent, but it would be hard to say it's appealing. I can see some people finding it charming but probably not great for wider appeal.

I agree with the guy who said some of the trees and foliage/rocks look a bit too basic. The houses look fine though in my opinion. But some of the trees look like a single green cone and nothing else. And bushes just a circle.
